description: This file defines a React functional component named RichEditor, which implements a rich text editor using the Tiptap library. It manages editor initialization, content updates, and integrates extensions for syntax highlighting, image uploads, and other rich text features. The component provides props for initial content, change handling, image uploads, and UI customization.

methods.name: RichEditor
methods.description: React component that renders a rich text editor with toolbar and image upload capabilities. Manages Tiptap editor instance, content synchronization, and user interactions.
